source.sourceFactText: Two point sources of light are separated by 24 cm; find placement of a converging lens of focal length 9 cm so their images occupy the same point.
sourceDoesNotSpecify: Which image is real or virtual

model.incidentDirections: left-source travels +x and right-source travels -x, lens strictly between
model.formula: For d>0 f>0, if lens x=a between the two sources x=0 and x=d, global image coordinates are xL=a+f*a/(a-f), xR=a-f*(d-a)/(d-a-f), when a!=f and d-a!=f. Their finite coincidence requires 2*a*(d-a)=f*d and the lens roots a=(d±sqrt(d*(d-2*f)))/2.
model.exactThreshold: If d=2f, the only algebraic midpoint root is a=f and both images are at infinity, so there is NO FINITE coincidence. If d<2f, no real between-source finite solution. If d>2f, two finite roots exist.
model.mathematicalImageX: For a root a, common global image x=a*d/(2*a-d). In the first branch the nearer-to-source-1 object is inside focal length (virtual image), source-2 outside focal length (real image); second branch reversed.
model.outsideLens: When a lens lies outside both separated sources, both are on the same side and the thin-lens imaging map of object distance is injective for distinct finite objects, so there is no common finite image.
model.nativeClaim: Native ideal lens rays can verify one branch's real ray crossing and the reverse-line virtual conjugate, but do NOT detect a shared physical optical image.

nativeWitness.note: Native rays must choose actual lens intersections; the analysis may check actual outgoing measured segments against the already-frozen inverse image coordinate, but cannot reframe a virtual backward extrapolation as a detector crossing.

evaluationAxes: genuine native ray evidence vs virtual extension
releaseGate: Only one final independent physics/integration review if the new analytical API is production-bound. Test-only probes do not authorize release. Do not merge prior to exact CI and review.
